chunks: My father and the group of my scholars narrated to me from Sa'd ibn 'Abdillah, who said: Ahmad ibn 'Ali ibn 'Ubayd al-Ju'fi narrated to me, who said: Muhammad ibn Abi Jarir al-Qummi narrated to me, who said: I heard Abu al-Hasan al-Rida (peace be upon him) saying:
To my father: Whoever visits al-Husayn ibn 'Ali (peace be upon him) knowing his right, will be among those whom Allah speaks to, above His Throne.
Verily the pious ones will be amidst gardens and springs in the seat of truth, in the presence of the omnipotent sovereign.
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual reward for visiting Imam Husayn with knowledge of his rights?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) elevates the status of the Ziyarah of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him) by linking it to the unique honor of being addressed directly by Allah above His Throne, a privilege reserved for the most distinguished servants. This tradition, recorded by Ibn Qulawayh, underscores the theological weight of 'knowing his rights' (Haqq) as a prerequisite for this divine intimacy. The cited verse from Surah Qaf serves as the scriptural foundation, connecting the physical act of pilgrimage to the ultimate spiritual reward of proximity to the Sovereign.
